# Brokerage notes

Account number 8842-991 at the brokerage, kept separate from retirement accounts since this money
needs to stay accessible rather than locked up until retirement age.

## Current allocation

Mostly VTSAX (total US market index) with a smaller slice of VTIAX (international) to avoid being
entirely exposed to one country's market. No individual stock picking here — the plan is boring on
purpose, since the freelance income already carries enough variability without adding stock-picking
risk on top of it.

## Rebalancing

Meant to check the allocation drift twice a year, but it's been closer to nine months since the last
look. International has drifted a bit under target given a good run domestically, so a rebalance is
overdue rather than optional at this point. See [[investment-glossary]] for what counts as
"drifted enough to matter" versus noise not worth acting on.
